title: Act 3 of 2014 - Tax Administration (Budget Amendment) Act 2014
text:
Tax Administration (Amendment)—3 of 2014 7
ACT NO. 3 OF 2014
I assent.
E. NAILATIKAU
President
[15 December 2014]
AN ACT
TO AMEND THE TAX ADMINISTRATION DECREE 2009
ENACTED by the Parliament of the Republic of Fiji—
Short title and commencement
1. This Act may be cited as the Tax Administration (Budget Amendment) Act 2014
and shall come into force on 1st January, 2015.
Section 111 amended
2. Section 111 of the Tax Administration Decree 2009 is amended by deleting “Auditor-
General” and substituting “Permanent Secretary for Finance or his or her appointed
representative”, wherever it appears.
Passed by the Parliament of the Republic of Fiji this 11th day of December 2014.
